title: Voz pasiva: los beneficios desiguales de la independencia

sections.content: A synthesis on who did and didn't benefit from independence needs passive voice constantly: a principle was proclaimed, a law was passed, a protection was eliminated, a right was not granted. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: En casi todas las nuevas constituciones, la ciudadanía fue proclamada igual para todos los hombres libres.
items.english: In almost every new constitution, citizenship was proclaimed equal for all free men.

items.spanish: Fueron aprobadas leyes de 'vientre libre', que declaraban libres solo a los hijos nacidos después de cierta fecha.
items.english: 'Free womb' laws were passed, declaring free only children born after a certain date.

items.spanish: Esa protección fue eliminada por muchas de las nuevas repúblicas, inspiradas en ideas liberales.
items.english: That protection was eliminated by many of the new republics, inspired by liberal ideas.

items.spanish: El derecho al voto no fue concedido a las mujeres en ningún país latinoamericano en el momento de la independencia.
items.english: The right to vote was not granted to women in any Latin American country at the time of independence.

sections.content: A negative passive (no fue concedido) is just as useful as a positive one for this kind of synthesis — sometimes the most important historical fact is precisely what was NOT done, and passive voice states that just as cleanly as it states what was.
